build_tpu_command_parser: build an argparse parser for the accelerate tpu-config command with TPU name, zone, and command arguments
run_tpu_command_launcher: run commands across TPU VMs via gcloud ssh with optional accelerate installation and config file defaults
run_tpu_main_entrypoint: run the accelerate tpu-config CLI entrypoint that parses arguments and launches TPU commands
test_tpu_command_parser: test the tpu_command_parser function to verify it creates a valid argparse parser with all expected arguments
review_tpu_command_launcher: review the tpu_command_launcher function that builds and executes gcloud commands on TPU pods
